event_summary: A stacked arrangement of red, yellow, and blue rectangular blocks changes when the yellow and blue blocks tip and move down to the tabletop while the red block stays upright.
raw_event_description: At the start, a red rectangular block stands upright on a wood-grain tabletop, a yellow rectangular block lies horizontally across its top, and a blue rectangular block stands vertically near the right side of the yellow block below partially visible orange-and-black prongs. For many frames the blocks remain in this arrangement. Then the yellow block tilts downward on its right side and the blue block moves down and to the right; both separate from the initial stacked arrangement. The red block remains upright. The yellow and blue blocks come to rest on the tabletop near the red block, with the orange-and-black prongs still visible near the top edge of the frame.

reasons: The red, yellow, and blue blocks are visible in a stacked arrangement.
The orange-and-black prongs are only partly visible at the top edge of the frame.
